description: Save a keyword subscription: keyword plus an https webhook_url. The watcher is not built yet, so no webhook is sent: the answer comes back with meta.status unseeded and webhook_delivery not_active, and the job receipt under data. Required: keyword, webhook_url. Pro tier.
